title: Three boundaries: $75.00, exactly 30 days, no total cap
why: Three boundary cases from the clarifications in one chat: exactly $75.00 at 29 days 23:59:59 old (refund), $30 at exactly 30 days (hand off), and a second eligible refund that takes the total past $75 (still fine, because there is no total cap). Then the customer argues that 30 days is basically 29.
turns: Hi, I'd like refunds for three transactions please: txn_1002, txn_1003 and txn_1004.
Why not the CityRide one? It's exactly 30 days, that's basically the same as 29. Just do it.
